$comment: Context-cache registry — the volatile half of Superscalar §5.4. The spec carries the discipline; this file carries the numbers, because vendor cadence rots numbers baked into prose. Every row cites the page it was confirmed against (confirmedBy). singleSource=true marks facts confirmed only against the vendor's own doc (no independent second domain yet) — usable, but flagged for promotion at the next revisit. Research trail: EstreGenesis-maintenance RESEARCH/context_caching_vendors_20260801 (claim ledger, verified 9 / unresolved 3 / refuted 0).

watchlist: Docs URL migrations measured live (docs.anthropic.com→platform.claude.com, platform.openai.com→developers.openai.com, both 301) — confirm old URLs still redirect, keep confirmedBy on the new hosts
OpenAI cache billing reshaped at GPT-5.6 (writes 1.25x + >=30min guarantee; pre-5.6 in_memory/24h retention options deprecated) — mixed-generation deployments split cache policy by model
Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview storage rent is 4.5x the standard rate — recheck when the Preview label drops
Anthropic Claude-5-family minimum cacheable threshold (512) is vendor-doc-only — promote with a second source
Harness absorption: Claude Code already automates TTL selection/downgrade — re-scope the skill's jurisdiction as more moves into the harness

anthropic.mechanism: opt-in cache_control breakpoints (max 4), hierarchical prefix tools→system→messages

minCacheableTokens.range: 512–4096 by model (Claude 5 family 512; most 4.x 1024; Haiku 4.5 / Opus 4.5–4.6 4096)

anthropic.notes: Thinking/effort parameter changes invalidate (model-dependent). Lookback window 20 blocks per breakpoint. Below-minimum prompts process uncached with no error.

openai.mechanism: automatic prefix caching (>=1024-token prefix, strict); prompt_cache_key routing hint + prompt_cache_breakpoint explicit split
openai.notes: GPT-5.6 family: Sol $5.00/$0.50/$30 (input/cached/output per 1M), Terra $2/$0.20/$12, Luna $0.20/$0.02/$1.20; writes Sol $6.25. Pre-5.6 retention options (in_memory / 24h) not carried forward.

gemini.mechanism: implicit caching (default-on, Gemini 2.5+) + explicit CachedContent (generateContent API only; hourly storage rent)
gemini.notes: Hit visibility: usage.total_cached_tokens. Rent model flips break-even to reuses-per-hour (measured secondary math: 200K ctx on Pro ≈ $0.90/h to hold, ≈$0.36 saved per hit → 2–3 reuses/hour).

deepseek.mechanism: automatic disk KV cache, default-on for all users; full prefix-unit match required (A+B then A+C misses)

ttl.eviction: unused caches cleared within hours to days (no guarantee, no control surface)

deepseek.notes: Cheapest hit of the four vendors, but no TTL guarantee and no breakpoint control — cheap and unpredictable.

claude-code.mainConversationTtl: 1h automatic on subscription auth (auto-downgrades to 5m while drawing usage credits); API-key/3rd-party default 5m, opt-in via ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1
invalidators: model switch (per-model caches; incl. opusplan plan-mode toggles and safety-classifier fallback)
effort change (per-effort caches; confirmation dialog shown)
fast mode first enable (request header joins the cache key; once per conversation)
MCP server connect/disconnect when tools load into the prefix (deferred tools are safe; can fire without user action — process death, HTTP expiry, auto-reconnect)
bare tool deny rule (built-in tool definitions live in the system-prompt layer; scoped rules like Bash(rm *) are safe)
compaction (conversation layer replaced by design; the summarization request itself reads the warm prefix)
Claude Code upgrade (system prompt/tool defs change; resuming a long session post-upgrade can be the most expensive request)

keepers.list: file edits · mid-session CLAUDE.md / output-style edits (also don't apply until reload) · permission-mode switches · skill/command invocation (appended as user messages) · /recap · /rewind (returns to an already-cached entry)

claude-code.scope: effectively per machine + directory (system prompt embeds cwd/platform/git snapshot; worktrees of the same repo do not share cache)
claude-code.measurement: cache_creation_input_tokens / cache_read_input_tokens per response; OpenTelemetry export per user+session
